item.text: Mongo can use one `$inc` update per key, which keeps that key’s fields atomic. Redis needs a per-key atomic script because a pipeline of separate `HINCRBY` commands could leave some fields changed if another field contains text. I’ll pipeline those scripts across keys and clear cache only for keys whose writes succeed.
